# <dl>

The description list element represents a collection of term-description pairs, such as glossaries, metadata, or key-value data.

- Native HTML element with Vanilla Breeze additions.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/native/dl/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<dl>
  <dt>HTML</dt>
  <dd>HyperText Markup Language — the standard markup
  language for documents.</dd>

  <dt>CSS</dt>
  <dd>Cascading Style Sheets — a style sheet language
  for presentation.</dd>

  <dt>JavaScript</dt>
  <dd>A programming language that enables interactive
  web pages.</dd>
</dl>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-variant` | `horizontal`, `stacked` |  |  |
| `data-bordered` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-density` | `compact` |  |  |
| `data-striped` | boolean |  |  |
